::: {#sol-sixteen}

| $1$ | $\log_2 n$ | $n$ | $n \log_2 n$ | $n^2$ | $2^n$ | $n!$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | 4 | 16 | 64 | 256 | 65536 | 20922789888000 |

The values are already in increasing order.
For $n!$, $1 \cdot 2 \cdots 16 = 20922789888000$, about $2 \times 10^{13}$.

:::
